devin: seeing a weird perf cliff on SM86 w/FA-v3 vs SM80, heads=48 -> selector chooses sdpa:v2 and it's much slower on long prefix paths
anya: ugh, repro? numbers? :eyes:
devin: yes, small repro script attached, but main observation: for seqlen 1-64 it picks flashattn:v3, >64 it flips to sdpa:v2 on SM86. latency jumps ~2.3x for heads=48, but for heads=64 it stays fine
samir: can you paste the kernel pick log? the autotuner output should show the score table
devin: here, from runtime debug mode:
```
[autotune] model: gpt-like, heads=48, head_dim=64, sm=86
[autotune] seqlen 32 -> pick flashattn_v3 tile=128 score=12.3
[autotune] seqlen 128 -> pick sdpa_v2 tile=64 score=9.1
[autotune] measured: flashattn_v3 4.6ms @seqlen32, sdpa_v2 10.7ms @seqlen128
```
anya: interesting that measured score doesn't match latency for prefix cases where kv-cache present
lee: could be KV cache alignment interacting with the kernel's shmem usage on sm86. FA-v3 expects contiguous KV layout for fused kernels, sdpa-v2 has different stride assumptions
devin: repro script toggles kvcache=true/false. with kvcache disabled the selector keeps FA-v3 and perf is fine even at seqlen 128
lee: that suggests the autotuner's offline benchmarks didn't simulate cache-backed requests. our heuristic for kv_cache_enabled wasn't in the cost model
samir: could also be quantization codepath: we have a fallback to sdpa for odd head dims to avoid bank conflicts. heads=48->head_dim=64 gives weird head_block math on sm86
anya: any differences between sm80 and sm86 kernel register pressure? perf-bot, can you run the quick perf counters for the sdpa_v2 case?
perf-bot: running counters for pid 12456 (sdpa_v2, seqlen=128, heads=48) -- L2 miss rate 21%, shared mem stall 12%, achieved occupancy 62%
samir: compared to flashattn_v3 at seqlen=32: L2 miss 9%, shared mem stall 3%, occupancy 78%
devin: so sdpa v2 uses more global mem for KV fallback, causing cache thrash on SM86 microarch
anya: short-term fix: add kv_cache flag into the autotune key so cached workloads prefer flashattn variants where applicable
lee: agree. also add head_dim parity check to avoid forcing sdpa for odd head_blocks on sm86. and add a small runtime microbenchmark that exercises longer seqlens with kvcache enabled during model onboarding
samir: will open a PR for: (1) include kv_cache in autotune key (2) prefer flashattn_v3 for kvcache=true when its measured latency within 15% of best (3) add onboarding microbench.
devin: thanks. can we also add a telemetry gauge to record when runtime falls back from FA->SDPA so we can monitor in prod? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
samir: yep will add event log and dashboard tile
deploy-bot: staging rollout of autotune patch scheduled for 2024-06-12 03:00 UTC (canary=10%) :rocket:
anya: awesome. assigning followups: samir (autotune patch + telemetry), lee (investigate sm86 shmem register layout), devin (test harness + repro). I'll file an incident ticket if we see customer impact. :+1:
